description: Election Commission - Order to appoint Mr. S.M. A. K. Manchanayaka to fill a vacancy in the Western Province Provincial Council
reasoning: This gazette notification specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in the Western Province Provincial Council through the electoral process. It involves the Election Commission's actions under the Provincial Councils Elections Act, including the nomination and declaration of a new member. This content falls squarely under electoral processes and related matters, making it a Type 7 (Elections) classification rather than a government personnel change (which would only cover executive branch appointments).
